senses.gloss: pr. n. pl. (b. h.) Maon, in Judaea. Mekh. Yithro, Baḥod. s. l. מ׳ יהודה.
מ׳, also בֵּית מ׳ Maon, Beth Maon, near Tiberias.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 139a:22">Sabb. 139ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>בי כנישתא דמ׳</he> the synagogue of M.; (<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 80">Gen. R. s. 80</cite>, beg. <he>בכנישתהון דמעונא</he>, read <he>דמְעוֹנָאֵי</he>; Y. Snh. II, end, 20ᵈ <he>בכ׳ בטיבריא</he>).
